scope: Fixed randomized sensitivity validation in one urban mesh, 48 trajectory clusters, 3 correlated snapshots per cluster, 2 reports per snapshot. Not a multi-city deployment failure rate.
primary: Paired PD with identical target paths/focus/beams: point served-UE echo versus entity RT served-UE echo. P_D threshold .9.
selection: All geometric cases retained regardless of target path availability. Analytic candidates use frozen original RCS prior. RT target evaluation power does not select beams. Serving beam index/SINR are observable communication CSI.
focus: Material draw 0, target-only reference paths supply a full-band reference focus independent of tested beam and evaluation material. Reports use its direction/range plus frozen Gaussian errors. Conditional detection as in original validation.
communication: RT desired channel with roof/handset terminal, strongest measured grid beam. Original corridor external-interference model, no in-car penetration. No MCS reduction. Below-floor communication states counted and excluded from sensing-admissible probes.
uncertainty: Original broad U1 settings, gap_k=19, psi_deg=90, epoch .1 s. Snapshot .9 s spacing is geometry sampling, not estimator epoch.
beams: Original three families. Boundary closest below/above .9 plus maximum-predicted-PD probe per family. These are diagnostic probes, not a full grant scheduler simulation.
target_power: Independent Gaussian path mean-power detection abstraction. Joint target/UE paths counted once as target signal. Environment-only echo power stays in original INR=10dB background.
materials: Two independent draws per trajectory in original declared scattering ranges, fixed across its snapshots. Reference draw 0 and evaluation draw 1.
pedestrian: Existing 1.75m ellipsoid proxy, epsilon_r=20, conductivity=1 S/m, diffuse coefficient=.2, not measured human tissue.
numerical: Primary 4M/source seed32. Prespecified 16M seed32 checks on frame1 of trajectory ids divisible by6. Also rerun any primary prediction-passing failure at higher rays for diagnosis, reported separately.
statistics: Counts are probe counts. Uncertainty resamples entire trajectories, retaining dependent frames/reports/families together. Paired differences evaluated on same probes.
